# Product Hunt

1 endpoint, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 1 standard (1 credit) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

Product Hunt's current launches: product name, tagline, product page URL, the maker's display name and the post's created and last-updated times, narrowed by topic slug or filtered by text. Votes, comments and ranks are not available here, so those fields are null. 1 credit a call.

## GET /v1/producthunt/launches - 1 credit (standard)

List current Product Hunt launches

**Cost** 1 credit (standard) · **Cache** 120s (a hit costs 0 credits) · **Returns** PostList · **Pagination** single page - The upstream feed is one document of about 50 entries with no pagination: page, day and before were probed 22/09/2026 and are ignored. Every entry the feed holds is returned in one call.
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.

Returns the launches Product Hunt is currently featuring, roughly 50 of them, each with its post ID, product name (post.ext.title), tagline (post.content.text), product page URL, the maker's display name, post.published_at (when the post was created, which can be weeks before its launch day) and post.ext.updated_at. Order is the feed's own and is not the vote ranking. Votes, comments and makers' handles are not available on this endpoint, so those fields are null. Narrow the list with topic, a Product Hunt topic slug such as artificial-intelligence, and filter it with query.

**Query params**

- `topic` (optional, string) - Product Hunt topic slug, as in producthunt.com/topics/<slug>, for example artificial-intelligence or developer-tools. A display name such as Developer Tools is converted to its slug. An unrecognised topic returns no launches, with a note in data._warnings, and costs nothing. · e.g. `artificial-intelligence`
- `query` (optional, string) - Case-insensitive text filter applied to the product name and tagline of the current launches. It filters this feed; it does not search Product Hunt's archive.

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/producthunt/launches" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
